features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.desc: Darkvision 120 feet (you can see through magical Darkness). For 2 Sorcery Points, you cast Darkness, which you can see through.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.desc: If you drop to 0 Hit Points (and aren't killed), you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.desc: For 3 Sorcery Points, you summon a shadow hound for 5 rounds: it hunts its target, imposes Disadvantage, and can grapple it.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.desc: While in Dim Light or Darkness, as a Bonus Action you teleport up to 120 feet to another shadow.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.desc: For 6 Sorcery Points, as an action you become a shadow for 1 minute: Resistance to all damage except Force, and you can move through objects.
